text:
Rae (Docs): opened a short quickref PR for Optimize toolkit (batching / kv cache / quant profiles). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/957 (WIP)
Diego H.: sweet. can we include tiny per-route examples for Node + Python + Go and a quick decision flow for when to pick q4_0 vs q8_0?
Rae (Docs): yup — keeping examples copy-pasteable. also a small mapping table for legacy profile names.
Priya N.: linkcheck CI found references to old model tag open-llama-13b; update to open-llama-13b-v2. also some SDK package names are stale.
ci-bot: ci/docs-linkcheck failed on PR #957: 2 broken links (docs/optkit/quickref.md lines 18, 44). logs: https://ci.redwood/957/linkcheck
Rae (Docs): fixed model refs and switched imports to new packages (@redwood/inference-js, redwood.inference, github.com/redwood/inference-go). pushed a commit.
bench-bot: quick benchmark (synth): q4_0 @ batch=6 median latency 40ms, q8_0 @ batch=6 median latency 58ms; token-cost delta ~ -30% for q4_0. gist: https://bench.redwood/q4q8-batch6
Diego H.: great, let's surface those numbers in a single-sentence tradeoff. teams like a concrete figure.
Rae (Docs): added a one-line decision tree: "If your eval shows acceptable quality on q4_0, use q4_0 for lower cost; otherwise use q8_0 and enable kv_prefetch to improve latency."
Priya N.: also call out when NOT to batch: sub-100ms SLOs, highly stateful multi-turn flows, or when deterministic token-by-token throughput is required.
Rae (Docs): added 'When to avoid aggressive batching' section. pasting snippets for sanity-check: 
```
// Node per-route: batching + kv prefetch
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-js';
const c = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});
await c.createRoute('summaries', {
  model: 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  batching: {maxTokensPerBatch: 1200, maxBatchSize: 6, timeoutMs: 10},
  kv_prefetch: {enabled: true, ttlSeconds: 300}
});
```
```
# Python per-route: batching + kv prefetch
from redwood.inference import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
client.create_route('answers', config={
  'model': 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  'batching': {'max_tokens_per_batch': 1200, 'max_batch_size': 6, 'timeout_ms': 10},
  'kv_prefetch': {'enabled': True, 'ttl_seconds': 180}
})
```
```
// Go per-route: batching + kv prefetch (pseudo)
import "github.com/redwood/inference-go"
cli := inference.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cli.CreateRoute("chat", inference.RouteConfig{Model: "open-llama-13b-v2", Batching: inference.BatchingConfig{MaxTokensPerBatch:1200, MaxBatchSize:6, TimeoutMs:10}, KvPrefetch: inference.KvPrefetch{Enabled:true, TtlSeconds:180}})
```
Rae (Docs): and the legacy->recommended mapping YAML (inline):
```
# quant-profiles.yml
legacy-small: q4_0  # test on your eval set, prefer q8_0 if quality drops
legacy-large: q8_0  # default for instruction-heavy workloads
```
Diego H.: small nit: use runtime default timeoutMs=10 in all snippets (looks consistent). also note that kv_prefetch reduces downstream token compute for repeated prefixes.
Rae (Docs): updated wording and added anchor id #optkit-quickref for release notes.
Priya N.: LGTM after one wording tweak: avoid future-tense, use imperative present-tense (e.g., "Enable KV prefetch for latency-sensitive reuse.").
Rae (Docs): fixed phrasing and added a short changelog entry under Unreleased. tagging @Diego H. and @Priya N. for final approvals. merging once CI is green. :sparkles:
